name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
November 9, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Javier Toyos, La Mirada Church of The Nazarene
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Councilmember Sarega
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF KIRA KIRA - It is recommended the City Council present Chunwoo Lim with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
5.1 Recognition of Kira Kira
5.2
ACHIEVEMENT RECOGNITION AWARD PRESENTED TO DR. ANGELO R. RICARTE - It is recommended the City Council induct Dr. Angelo R. Ricarte into the Achievement Recognition Program.
5.2 Recognition of Dr. Angelo R. Ricarte
5.3
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA ARMADA ATHLETES - It is recommended the City Council recognize La Mirada Armada Head Coach Rick Shipherd and Armada swim club member Kayla Han and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.3 Recognition of La Mirada Armada Athletes
5.4
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEES FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Helene Duarte and Jorge Orozco for their years of service and present them with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.4 Recognition of City Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of October 26, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of 10-26-21
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated November 9, 2021 in the total amount of $2,282,996.30.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
PHANTOM PROJECTS FUNDING REQUEST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 - It is recommended the City Council grant Phantom Projects’ Fiscal Year 2021-22 in-kind funding request in the amount of $90,580.
7.3 Phantom Projects Funding Request
7.4
APPROVAL OF FACILITY USE FOR LOVE LA MIRADA TO HOST AN APPRECIATION DINNER FOR FIRST RESPONDERS - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for use of the Neff Barn for Love La Mirada’s appreciation dinner event and waive all rental fees associated with the proposed use.
7.4 Approval of Facility Use
7.5
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING SEPTEMBER 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending September 2021.
7.5 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.6
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending September 2021.
7.6 Monthly Investment Report
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-02, REPLACEMENT OF MARQUEE DISPLAY AT LA MIRADA THEATRE – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the marquee replacement installed by National Sign & Marketing Corporation; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.7 CIP No. 2021-02
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
PUBLIC HEARING TO RECEIVE INPUT FROM THE COMMUNITY REGARDING THE REDRAWING OF ELECTION DISTRICT BOUNDARIES - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing to receive input from the community regarding the redrawing of election district boundaries.
8.1 PH - Redistricting
Public Map 1
Public Map 2
Public Map 3
Public Map 4
NDC Map 5
NDC Map 6
Communities of Interest 1
Communities of Interest 2
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 720 ADDING ARTICLE IX (MANDATORY ORGANIC WASTE DISPOSAL REDUCTION) TO CHAPTER 6.08 (SOLID WASTE AND RECYCLABLES COLLECTION SERVICES) OF TITLE 6 (HEALTH AND SANITATION) TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 720 adding Article IX (Mandatory Organic Waste Disposal Reduction) to Chapter 6.08 (Solid Waste and Recyclables Collection Services) of Title 6 (Health and Sanitation) to the La Mirada Municipal Code and affirm the CEQA Exemption.
9.1 Ordinance No. 720 - Second Reading
10.
CITY COUNCIL REPORTS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
11.
CITY ATTORNEY ANNOUNCEMENTS
12.
CITY MANAGER ANNOUNCEMENTS
13.
ADJOURNMENT
I hereby certify, under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
____________________________________
Leticia Revilla, City Clerk
